model.name: On /model, selecting a tree node opens the drawer (node-detail + reachable diagram / method signature)
model.description: Tron device-QA (2026-07-30): on the /model page, selecting a tree node does NOTHING - no drawer opens. ROOT (measured, PO): serverModelPage (server.ts:999) mounts <rb-trace-tree id='model-tree'> but NO <rb-detail-drawer> (the /trace page mounts BOTH tree + drawer) - so a selection has nothing to open. This is the 2nd 'gated loads but does not WORK' device-QA miss of the MDA arc (R32.9 = feature not listed; R32.10 = drawer not opening) - [[device-qa-regression-means-missing-ac]] + [[gate-the-ac-surface]]: gate at the INTERACTION surface (select -> drawer opens), not page-load. FIX (scenario-first, feature-completion, architect -> expert -> tester): the /model page mounts the SHARED rb-detail-drawer (+ the R32.4 rb-diagram-detail via the drawer tagMap), mirroring /trace - NO fork; selection drives the standard renderDetailForRef flow. Selecting a CLASS opens its node-detail + reachable diagram (R32.4 boxes + R32.6 edges); selecting a MEMBER/method opens its signature-detail. Gated @390 at the interaction.

discoverySource.note: 2nd 'gated-loads-not-works' miss (after R32.9). PO measured the root: serverModelPage mounts rb-trace-tree but not rb-detail-drawer. Gate at the interaction (select->drawer-opens->detail/diagram/method-signature), not page-load.

model.crossRefNote: R32.10 completes the /model interaction: the R32.3 tree + R32.4 diagram (rb-diagram-detail) + R32.6 edges already exist as shared components; the /model page just needs the shared rb-detail-drawer mounted (mirroring /trace) so selection opens them. Sibling of R32.9 (both are gated-loads-not-works device-QA misses closed by gating the INTERACTION surface, not page-load).

acceptanceCriteria.text: PART A / INV-M1 (client-only, mirror /scenario) - model.ts (src/public/ts/model/model.ts) imports rb-detail-drawer (which self-imports rb-diagram-detail + the type-detail elements), createElement('rb-detail-drawer') and appends it to .trace-page (like scenario-view.ts:38-41 / trace-page.ts:35-37); the SHARED selectionModel / 'selection-changed' event then opens it. This ALONE fixes 'no drawer opens' - NO fork (the drawer is the shared component; model.ts:4 previously imported ONLY rb-trace-tree).

PART B / INV-M2 - selecting a tree CLASS node opens a TYPED node-detail via a NEW rb-modelelement-detail element registered in the drawer tagMap for a 'modelelement' ref (the drawer already has 'diagram:' from R32.4 but NOT modelelement, so class/member fall to generic today). The class detail shows its «kind» + members (each a dv-link drilling to the member's signature) + relations - via the standard selection -> renderDetailForRef flow, no fork.

The class detail carries a '📐 Open diagram' dv-link -> diagram:<uuid> -> rb-diagram-detail (R32.4 UML boxes + R32.6 edges) - the diagram is REACHABLE from the class. Diagram-reach needs ONE small server touch: /api/model/tree ALSO emits the store Diagram unit as a root (type:diagram) and/or a per-class diagramUuid, so the dv-link resolves.
Selecting a MEMBER / method tree node (or drilling into it from the class detail's members) opens its SIGNATURE-detail (the member's signature + detail) in the drawer.

INV-M3 (gate unchanged) - the R32.9 /model gate is PRESERVED (requireFeatureAccess('Model-Driven Code Quality') still 403s a non-member; drawer-mount does not weaken it). Acceptance is GATED at the INTERACTION @390 (Tron viewport): select -> drawer OPENS, class -> reachable diagram, method/attr -> signature - NOT at page-load (the page rendering the tree is NOT sufficient) [[gate-the-ac-surface]]. This is the 2nd 'gated-loads-not-works' miss (R32.9 not-listed; R32.10 drawer-not-opening) - a device-QA regression = a missing AC.

model.acFinalizedNote: 5 ACs FINALIZED to the APPROVED architect design (design-mda-model.md ## R32.10, 16e64e445; 2026-07-30) - adopt-not-invent. Root confirmed: model.ts:4 imports ONLY rb-trace-tree, never creates rb-detail-drawer (/scenario + /trace do). PART A (INV-M1, client-only) = mount the shared rb-detail-drawer -> selectionModel opens it (fixes 'no drawer opens'). PART B (INV-M2) = NEW rb-modelelement-detail + tagMap 'modelelement' (typed class/member detail + '📐 Open diagram' dv-link -> R32.4/6). Diagram-reach = one small server touch (/api/model/tree emits the Diagram root type:diagram / per-class diagramUuid). INV-M3 gate unchanged. REUSE rb-detail-drawer + rb-diagram-detail + selectionModel, NO fork. Anticipated chain (mints on build, IMPL-MINT): UC modelElement.inspect -> Class RbModelElementDetail -> Method render/mount -> Impl -> Test (+ serverModelPage / model-tree ext for the diagram-root). DEPLOY: Part A is client; the diagram-root server touch -> real restart + boot-verify on ship. DEFERRED (architect-flagged in the design doc): ROOT B = real RawBin MULTI-FILE model -> R33 (Tron authorizes) - noted for PO (sibling of the R32.8 model-sync multi-file backlog item). GATE @390 at the INTERACTION, not page-load.
